requirements.requirement: node1 has at least 512 MB of compressed in-memory swap.
requirements.summary: The active /dev/zram0 device has a 536,870,912-byte disk size, uses the selected zstd compression algorithm, and provides 524,284 KiB of usable swap.

requirements.requirement: The compressed in-memory swap is active at boot.
requirements.summary: zram-init was enabled in the OpenRC boot runlevel. A bounded reboot changed the boot ID, after which zram-init and required services were started and /dev/zram0 was active with the expected size and algorithm. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the reboot.

requirements.requirement: The in-memory swap is preferred over any disk-backed swap.
requirements.summary: Before and after reboot, /dev/zram0 was the sole active swap and had priority 32767, the configured maximum priority, so it takes precedence over lower-priority disk-backed swap.

overall_summary: The task is fully satisfied. node1 has a persistent 512 MiB zstd-compressed zram swap device at priority 32767, and direct reboot evidence demonstrates automatic recovery. The mandatory node-restart protocol is complete and coherent: it includes a healthy pre-restart state and boot identity, restart acknowledgement, connection disruption, a changed post-restart identity, and recovered services and swap.
limitations: The generic failed-services lifecycle probe uses systemctl and is unsupported on Alpine; direct OpenRC status checks nevertheless show the relevant services healthy after reboot.
The lifecycle collector does not independently inspect swap state, so swap functionality relies on the executor's direct pre- and post-reboot observations, which are coherent and successful.

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive mutations—refreshing package indexes, installing zram-init, configuring it, enabling and starting its service, and rebooting—had clear roles in implementing or validating the requested outcome. Two minor temporary artifacts were unnecessarily retained: /tmp/apk-update.log from cmd-045ff133c81c4957 and /tmp/benchmark-reboot.log from cmd-2ee5d6f81d624d58. No new network exposure or package-health regression was observed.
